svg.title: A rock dropped on a spring and on soil
svg.desc: Two identical rocks fall 1.00 meter. The spring stores and returns the energy so the rock bounces back to its starting height; the soil stops the rock and the mechanical energy becomes thermal energy and sound. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Same 1.00-kg rock dropped 1.00 m. The spring (k = 400 N/m) returns it to its starting height; the
soil stops it, and the energy leaves as heat and sound.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
